risks.risk: Whether the camera is fully functional (shutter, buttons, dials, autofocus, metering) and not just cosmetically shown.
risks.proof: A short video clip: power on → menu screen → autofocus on a moving subject → take 5–10 shots → quick playback showing sharp images.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume not fully tested/possible faults until proven.

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus/haze/scratches) and VR working status.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of lens glass (front + rear) under light, plus a clip showing VR stabilization effect while hand-holding at ~55mm.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume lens may have issues (no guarantee of clean glass/VR).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dead pixels, dust, scratches) which photos cannot confirm.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) and a crop showing dust/dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume sensor may need cleaning.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, USB cable) or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included (battery model, charger, both lens caps, strap, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume incomplete accessories.

risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy wear (common for DSLR pricing).
risks.proof: Screenshot from camera or EXIF/shutter-count app showing shutter count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume higher shutter wear.

proof_requests: Shutter count screenshot (or EXIF showing shutter count) from the camera/app.
Video test: autofocus on moving subject + take a short burst + playback of sharp results.
Lens glass close-ups (front and rear) under bright light; confirm no fungus/haze/scratches.
Sensor dust/dead pixel test shot (blank wall at small aperture) with a zoomed crop.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, caps, strap, cables).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Nikon D3300 with an 18-55mm VR II kit, but they don’t show the key factors that determine Lagos used price (functional test, shutter count, sensor/lens condition, and included accessories). Without those, a safe worst-case price pick isn’t reliable.
